1020.evidence: Grand Theft Auto V. IGDB's only PS5 row is the 2025-03-15 next-gen patch. Rockstar released the PS5 version on 15 Mar 2022 (announced Dec 2021, reported by EGM, Windows Central, The AU Review).

135400.evidence: Minecraft. IGDB's 20 Jun 2024 PS5 'Early Access' row is the announcement of the native PS5 version (Game Informer, 21 Jun 2024), not a playable early access; the native PS5 version released 22 Oct 2024 (Gematsu 'Minecraft coming to PS5 on October 22'; Push Square, Oct 2024, 'native PS5 port is now available').

182278.evidence: MultiVersus. The 26 Jul 2022 PS5 'Early Access' row is the 2022 open beta of a game Player First Games rebuilt for the 28 May 2024 relaunch (The Sixth Axis, 11 Mar 2024, 'MultiVersus is relaunching on 28th May'; Co-Optimus, 'will return and fully launch on May 28'). Treated as a separate build, so d stays the 2024 launch.

306055.evidence: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus. IGDB's 20 Dec 2022 PS5 'Early Access' row has no early access behind it that we could find; the game's PS Store listing is the PS1 classic, so d stays the 14 Jun 2024 full release row until a source shows a real PS5 early access.

152243.evidence: Slime Rancher 2. IGDB's PS5 'Early Access' row is 7 Jun 2024, the first day of pre-order advance access (four days early). The public PS5 Early Access launch was 11 Jun 2024 (Gematsu 'Slime Rancher 2 Early Access coming to PS5 on June 11', 25 Apr 2024; Push Square, Apr 2024). Advance access does not count as early access (r052 rule), so the public day is d. The 1.0 followed on 23 Sep 2025.

195077.evidence: Ed-0: Zombie Uprising. IGDB's PS5 'Early Access' row is 12 Jul 2023, one day before the 1.0. The game's only early access was on Steam (since April 2022); the PS5 and Xbox Series versions launched together with the full release on 13 Jul 2023 (TechRaptor, 29 Mar 2023; Anime News Network press release, 18 May 2023).
